integrity: A standalone standard-library verifier reproduces rational update matrices, positive-definite certificates and the repeated-full-batch path identity; the infinite-time argument is analytical. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two scalar dual blocks, exact arithmetic, specified strongly convex quadratics and constant step sizes; independent selection across iterations; intermediate sampling-correlation interval remains unclassified. The theorem does not claim nonlinear or general-dimensional behavior, a sharp global threshold, or almost-sure divergence.
title: Correlated dual batches can reverse mean-square stability in stochastic primal-dual hybrid gradient
